side.notes: The measured FishBase lateral image and two exact licensed adult file pages agree on a slender compressed trunk, short head, large eye, dorsal and anal origins, small adipose fin, narrow peduncle, and forked caudal.

top.uncertainty: High. No calibrated orthographic dorsal original was found; moving oblique views show only qualitative lateral compression.
top.notes: The rejected fable-v1 looked cylindrical from above. Revised station half-widths reduce the midbody width-to-depth ratio from 0.505 to 0.374 while staying symmetrical and explicitly inferred.

front.uncertainty: High. No verified sharp orthographic frontal original was found, and video frames include motion and perspective distortion.
front.notes: The rejected fable-v1 looked cylindrical from the front. Revised head and trunk half-widths create a clearly compressed section without changing the verified lateral outline, eye, or body depth.

silhouetteLandmarks.name: slender compressed trunk and narrow caudal peduncle
silhouetteLandmarks.notes: The station envelope retains FishBase's 26 percent total-length body depth and verified lateral silhouette. Narrower half-widths now produce a visibly compressed trunk that tapers continuously into a short, fine peduncle.

silhouetteLandmarks.name: short head, large seated eye, and small terminal mouth
silhouetteLandmarks.notes: Head stations target the measured 18.5 percent total-length head while the eye control reflects the unusually large 45.9 percent eye-diameter to head-length ratio.

silhouetteLandmarks.name: triangular dorsal, small adipose, low anal, paired fins, and forked caudal
silhouetteLandmarks.notes: Median and paired fin positions follow the FishBase predorsal, prepelvic, and preanal ratios. A dedicated adipose mesh and deeply forked symmetrical caudal preserve the exact adult lateral cues.

proportions.name: standard length divided by total length
proportions.notes: The source body from snout tip to caudal base is 29 mm within a 35 mm total-length envelope, a ratio of 0.829 and within rounding of the FishBase measured 0.826.

proportions.name: body depth divided by total length
proportions.notes: The 9.1 mm midbody depth divided by the 35 mm display total length is exactly 0.26.

proportions.name: head length divided by total length
proportions.notes: The 5.5 mm snout-tip to operculum station interval is 15.7 percent of the display total length, intentionally conservative because the operculum station is not the FishBase posterior head landmark. Head, snout, and eye placement require visual review after build.

proportions.name: eye diameter divided by head length
proportions.notes: A 2.7 mm authored eye diameter over the conservative 5.5 mm operculum-to-snout interval is 0.491. Candidate review must verify that the shared eye plan does not make this large eye look protrusive.

proportions.name: adult display total length
proportions.uncertainty: Moderate. FishBase records 2.5 cm maximum standard length and a 3.0 cm total-length morphometric specimen, while USGS reports 4 cm. The source chooses a representative 3.5 cm display adult between those records.
proportions.notes: The display scale is explicit and source-bounded rather than presented as a single published maximum.

proportions.name: midbody width divided by body depth
proportions.uncertainty: High. FishBase provides lateral body depth but no calibrated width, and no verified orthographic top or frontal source was found.
proportions.notes: The revised 3.4 mm full width over the preserved 9.1 mm midbody depth corrects the cylindrical fable-v1 section while keeping the width explicitly provisional.

colorPatternBoundaries.name: iridescent blue eye-to-adipose lateral band
colorPatternBoundaries.notes: A narrow, gently arced procedural band begins behind the eye and now fades within the authored adipose-fin span rather than continuing to the caudal base. Deterministic blue-cyan variation suggests iridescence without pretending to reproduce true view-dependent guanine platelet optics.

colorPatternBoundaries.name: posterior-only red ventrolateral band
colorPatternBoundaries.notes: The red mask starts as a narrow anterior point near midbody, deepens progressively across the posterior flank, and reaches the caudal base below the blue stripe. This tapered boundary replaces the rejected rectangular slab and remains diagnostic against a cardinal tetra.

colorPatternBoundaries.name: olive-translucent dorsum, silver belly, and clear fins
colorPatternBoundaries.notes: Procedural vertical blends separate the subdued olive dorsum from the silvery belly. The revised caudal uses a neutral pale tint and 0.14 to 0.34 alpha range so it reads as a clear ray-supported membrane rather than an opaque brown tail.

previousCandidate.notes: The technically validated candidate preserved the correct lateral length, depth, head, and forked tail, but independent visual review rejected its cylindrical top/front section, caudal-reaching blue stripe, rectangular posterior red patch, and opaque caudal material.

repairSource.notes: The handwritten v2 source narrows only body half-widths, moves the blue posterior fade into the adipose span, tapers the red band from midbody to the fuller posterior flank, and makes the caudal membrane clear. Lateral station positions, body depth, head, fork geometry, and validated animation values remain unchanged.

mismatches.note: Rejected: the body read as cylindrical. V2 reduces trunk and head half-widths, with a midbody width-to-depth ratio of 0.374, while preserving the verified lateral length and 0.26 depth-to-length ratio.
Rejected: the blue band extended toward the caudal base. V2 begins its posterior fade at U 0.14 and completes it at U 0.23, aligned to the adipose-fin span.
Rejected: the posterior red area looked like a rectangular slab. V2 narrows it to a point near midbody and increases its vertical fill gradually toward the caudal base.
Rejected: the forked tail looked opaque and brown. V2 retains the correct fork silhouette but uses a pale neutral tint and a substantially lower alpha range.
The compression repair is source-grounded but still inferred. A v2 build requires independent top/front review because no verified orthographic width source exists.
The procedural color approximates the blue-cyan appearance in static display space and cannot reproduce the real stripe's angle-, light-, and physiological-state-dependent reflection.

uncertainty: True orthographic top and front proportions remain unmeasured. Fable-v1 was technically validated but visually rejected. The repaired v2 source remains unbuilt and requires independent visual review; adult display length remains a bounded representative value rather than a newly claimed species maximum.
